opportunities.title: Small Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though individuals may apply if they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth, education and sport, typically £1,500‑£5,000.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; practitioners, managers, carers and others in health‑related fields are also welcome. Preference for those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration and early‑career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in the UK and Japan, up to £10,000 per year (max £30,000 for multi‑year projects).
